snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online - Launch Trailer | PS5
snippet.description: Experience blockbuster hits Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online – Out now on PlayStation 5 with stunning visuals, faster loading, adaptive triggers, haptic feedback, Tempest 3D audio and more. Get GTA Online for FREE* exclusively on PS5 until June 14, 2022. * Download from PS5 console store. PS Plus required to play (recurring fees apply).
